slides.right:
SELECT *
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = c.id;
slides.why: ON / WHERE bhoole to **accidental cross join** → rows ka dhamaka 💥 (MySQL JOIN bina ON bhi chala deta)

points: Galti se bina ON = **rows ka dhamaka**
